name: Paycor Stadium
sources: Cincinnati Bengals (bengals.com, 2015-08-13, 'Bengals will Unveil Dramatic Stadium Improvements Tomorrow Night vs. Giants'): 'The main video boards are more than twice the size of the previous boards, measuring 130-by-36 feet.' Its sideline LED boards ('stretch the entire length of the sidelines') have no published size and are not built.

Wikipedia, Paycor Stadium (fetched 2026-09-25, st/renov/CIN.txt): 'The scoreboards and ribbons were later upgraded after the 2014 off-season to larger HD models'; the new, larger videoboard of the renovation is planned from 2027, so 2026 keeps the 2015 boards.

The retail s06 cityscape (PROVED OFFLINE): its lit city (LIGHT_city1 and LIGHT_city2, up to 122 m) stands at -x and +z, where downtown lies north-east of the stadium; so +z is north and +x west (the frame of PIT and CLE).

The retail s06 scene (PROVED OFFLINE): the south board is a 24.0 x 8.2 m feed quad (group378, jumbo_tron) on a housing over the south stands (group377: its front at z -101.6 from x -23.6 to 23.0, y 22.1 to 32.2, on two legs, with sponsor panels in signsA1, the control-room windows above it from 32.2 to 34.5 m and a canopy); the north-west corner board is a 22.2 x 8.9 m feed quad in a frame box (group378) on a housing angled toward the field (group496: a 39.5 m front from (21.1, 104.6) to (58.2, 91.1), y 31.5 to 44.1, with signsA1 panels). The play clocks (group378) stay at the goal posts.

Commons 'Paul Brown Stadium interior 2017.jpg' (2017-06-16): the south board on its two legs under the control room, the Roebling bridge behind it. Commons 'Bengals Super Bowl pep rally' (2022-02-07; 51868868462 and 51870150619): the north-west corner board on its housing under a canopy, beside the west stand.

DESIGN: the south board centred on its housing (x -20.11 to 19.51), 0.45 m in front of it, its frame's top at the control-room windows' sill (32.2 m); the north-west board across its housing's whole front (39.6 m), 1.0 m in front of it (the old feed's frame box stays inside the new board's body), centred on the old feed's height (32.46 to 43.44 m). The housings' sponsor panels (signsA1: the old boards' housings, which the rule lets the kit remove) are cut. Frames and bodies are the plain retail floor concrete (concreteFloor1) at a dark grey, with no stretched texture on the backs. The team's stripe panels and the sponsor headers the photos show are not built.
